fields.label: Enable Austrian Post Integration
fields.description: When unchecked, Austrian Post cancellation API calls are skipped (the ERPNext cancellation still proceeds and is logged).

fields.label: SOAP Endpoint URL
fields.description: Full URL of the Austrian Post ShippingService SOAP endpoint. Used as the default for both Import and Cancel unless overridden below.

fields.label: Austrian Post Base URL
fields.description: Austria-only integration. All operations use the single SOAP Endpoint URL above; the operation is selected by the SOAPAction header (configured below) — there is no separate per-operation URL.

fields.label: Import SOAPAction
fields.description: SOAPAction header sent for the ImportShipment (create) operation.

fields.label: Cancel SOAPAction
fields.description: SOAPAction header sent for the CancelShipments operation.

fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: Austrian Post ClientID sent in ImportShipment requests.

fields.label: Customs Option ID (Art der Sendung)
fields.description: Austrian Post ColloArticleRow.CustomsOptionID — "Art der Sendung", the customs category sent for every article. 1 = Sale of goods (default), 2 = Gift, 3 = Documents, 4 = Commercial Sample, 5 = Return of goods, 6 = Other. Leave at 1 for normal sales; a wrong value declares a wrong customs category.

fields.label: Tracking (SFTP)
fields.description: The Post drops POSTTRACK_*.xml tracking-event files on their SFTP server daily at 08:00, 12:00 and 17:00; the scheduler fetches them shortly after.

fields.label: Enable Post Tracking Import
fields.description: When unchecked, the SFTP fetch job returns without connecting.

fields.label: SFTP Directory
fields.description: Remote directory containing the tracking files. Leave empty for the login directory.

fields.label: Filename Prefix
fields.description: Only files starting with this prefix (and ending in .xml) are fetched.

fields.label: Move Files on Server After Import
fields.description: Off by default: files may stay in place — name + content-hash dedup makes re-reading them harmless, and the Post server may be read-only for us.
